programs.name: chrome-for-testing
programs.source: Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.47 linux64 (CfT Stable, latest-versions-per-milestone 156, revision 1706539; replaces 156.0.8078.47 for the Chrome 155/156 security fixes, 2026-10-20 stable release). D-A1 interim engine, x86_64 only. sha256 is ours; Google publishes x-goog-hash md5=cvpoYXzFXs9OK75pfi91hA== crc32c=3+SPsQ== (md5 matches the download, last-modified 2026-10-19). Linked libraries (NEEDED of chrome and its bundled .so files) are the same set as 154: the browser first-use closure plus the base (libgbm1, libx11-6, libglib2.0-0t64, libdbus-1-3, libudev1, libatspi2.0-0t64) and the baked libxkbcommon0.

programs.name: cmux-browser-host
programs.source: manaflow-ai/cmux release cmux-browser-host-v1.0.0-r1 (2026-10-24; tag on 4cf5c4ccc7c5, a feat-cmux-next commit; tag run 40082002418). A host-only release ([package.metadata.cmux-release] revision 1): the binary prints the one cmux-next version, 1.0.0. Adds to 1.0.0: goto after a router hash change, new-document snapshot diffs, the host world at once, headless clicks without the human pointer path. sha256 and size of both archives from the release SHA256SUMS and downloads. Archive: LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, bin/cmux-browser-host (glibc floor 2.31).

programs.name: agent-desktop
programs.source: vercel-labs/agent-desktop release v1.0.2 (2026-10-30, Apache-2.0; docs/install.md: a native archive with its platform helper kept beside the executable). Computer use through the AT-SPI accessibility tree (at-spi2-core is in the base set; X11 input needs libxtst6, display role). Archive: agent-desktop and agent-desktop-linux-clipboard-owner (its helper, found beside the binary through the store link), linked only against libc and libgcc_s. sha256 and size from the release asset digests and checksums.txt; gh attestation verify --repo vercel-labs/agent-desktop passed on the x86_64 archive.

programs.name: cmux-rd
programs.source: manaflow-ai/cmux release cmux-rd-v0.2.3 (2026-11-09; tag on fd8a53265837, feat-cmux-next after #39099 and #39159; release run 42567226980). The cmux.rd/1 Linux host (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-rd-host, scripts/release.py), with the UDP datagram link (cap link.udp, --link-stun). sha256 and size from checksums.txt, the release asset digest and the download. Archive: LICENSE (GPL-3.0-or-later), THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, bin/cmux-rd. OpenH264 is not in it: cmux-rd openh264-install fetches Cisco's binary on the machine.
